purpose: Implement ADR-4149: one deterministic git-and-globs verb that judges hand separation over a pull request's commits and prints one line a gate can quote.
responsibilities: src/audit/separation.js (new): range resolution, merge skip, trailer parse (Hand:, Separation-Reason:), path classification, per-commit verdicts; no network, no chain read.
src/cli/separation.js (new) and the audit router: flags, the report line, --json rows, the exit table.
.github/workflows/ci.yml: a pull_request step with fetch-depth 0 running rcf audit separation.
internalStructure: Pure classifier over (path, class table) and verdict function over (declared hand, classes touched); git is read through one spawn seam like resolveGitBranch in src/cli/finalise.js.

interfaces.name: rcf audit separation
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf audit separation [--base <ref>] [--head <ref>] [--require-hand] [--json]
Prints "separation: PASS <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author <n>, builder <n>, verifier <n>, stage-keeper <n>, neutral <n>, undeclared <n>, exceptions <n>" or "separation: FAIL <k> of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=<hand> touches <path>". Exit 0 pass, 4 violation, 2 bad ref, 1 not a git repository.

interfaces.name: rcf/separation.json
interfaces.description: Optional override of the default path classes: { classes: { <class>: [globs] } }. Inside rcf/ so only the test-author hand may change it.

interfaces.name: SeparationRow
interfaces.description: --json row per commit: { sha, subject, hand, declared, classes, verdict: pass | fail | exception, reason, paths }

notes: No schema change. Trailer is self-declared; the scoped Review gate stays the backstop.
name: rcf audit separation: hand trailer, path classes, one quotable line
